message.content: {"call_911_if": [{"id": "b1", "text": "Call your doctor or 911 if you have trouble breathing or your lips turn blue.", "sources": ["p1:L16", "p1:L17"]}, {"id": "b2", "text": "Call your doctor or 911 if you have a fever over 101 F after 3 days on antibiotics.", "sources": ["p1:L16", "p1:L18"]}, {"id": "b3", "text": "Call your doctor or 911 if you have new confusion.", "sources": ["p1:L16", "p1:L19"]}, {"id": "b4", "text": "Call your doctor or 911 if your blood sugar is over 300 twice in a row.", "sources": ["p1:L16", "p1:L20"]}]}
